records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: An internal operational tool for dispatch-desk reconciliation of mismatched references. Operators compared an overnight spreadsheet with the daily export; the tool surfaced understandable exceptions, including visible warnings for late source files and visible empty rows. Ada personally built the Python parser and SQL checks, using Git for version control and PostgreSQL for the production database. Supervisors made final dispatch decisions.

records.title: Reconciliation time reduction
records.subtitle: Harbor Tools
records.summary: Team result: reconciliation time fell from 5 hours to 2 hours per week over six weekly runs. Ada’s stated contribution was the parser and checks; coworkers also changed their checking habits. Delivery speed was not measured, and the earlier 50% time-saved figure was corrected as wrong.

decisions.reason: The profile summary and denial claims match the source; the surrounding sentence clarifies that AWS and medical compliance systems are included in “I have never used.”
The role, dates, project work, training, documentation, requirements gathering, supervisor communication, and corrected payroll start date are supported.

The summary presents visible late-file warnings as a feature the tool surfaced, but the source only says operators preferred such a warning. The source does not establish that this preference was implemented.
The source supports personally training 12 coworkers in two workshops and writing the handbook; it also says exact workshop dates are unavailable.
The reduction, six-run measurement, team attribution, personal contribution, coworker contribution, and correction of the earlier percentage are supported.
The source states that Ada wrote the Python parser herself.
The source states that Ada wrote the SQL checks herself.
The source identifies PostgreSQL as the production database for the work.
The source states that Ada used Git for version control.
The source supports training dispatch coworkers in workshops.
The source states that Ada gathered Dispatch Loom requirements from warehouse supervisors.
The source says Ada “would” sit beside a supervisor and work through an example; that may describe habitual past practice, but the record states it as completed work.
